sources.title: Visa on Arrival in Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: Bangladesh Police's live Special Branch service states conditional arrival-visa cohorts and issuance at entry, but it does not directly establish an ordinary Brazilian tourist route without the stated mission or reciprocal conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The immigration officer at the point of entry will grant VOA after reviewing all pertinent documents.

sources.title: Visa
sources.publisher: Embassy of Burkina Faso in Brazil
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Burkina Faso embassy page in Brasília directs applicants to the state eVisa service, but publishes no ordinary Brazilian-passport eligibility result or actual pair-specific issuance decision.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les postulants peuvent obtenir leur visa par voie électronique en fournissant les informations nécessaires.

sources.title: e-Visa
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's live state e-government page confirms electronic delivery after approval, but does not publish an ordinary Brazilian-passport eligibility or exemption schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: Liberia Immigration's live service makes the arrival route depend on the traveler's local Liberian-mission availability, so it does not establish a Brazilian-passport-only visitor baseline.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Entrée au Niger
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Nigeriens Abroad
sources.officialityEvidence: Niger's live Foreign Ministry entry page retains agreement exceptions and a residence-dependent mission route, so it does not identify Brazil's ordinary-passport exemption position or one unconditional issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: tous les étrangers qui souhaitent se rendre au Niger, sont tenus de présenter un visa nigérien, sauf en cas d'exemption.

sources.title: Saudi eVisa terms and conditions
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Saudi eVisa terms identify the Ministry of Tourism as the service operator, explicitly name Brazil in the current permitted-country list, and describe emailed electronic issuance for an accepted application.

policies.title: Brazilian ordinary passports: Saudi eVisa for short visitor travel
policies.summary: Saudi Arabia's current Ministry of Tourism eVisa terms expressly name Brazil as a permitted country and state that an accepted eVisa is emailed to the applicant.
conditions: Limited to ordinary Brazilian-passport short visitor travel under the official eVisa terms; diplomatic, official, service, special-document and other visa routes are outside scope.
The terms list Brazil as a current Permitted Country and require a valid passport with at least six months remaining from entry.
An accepted eVisa is emailed as an attachment; it is multi-entry, valid for one year from issuance, and allows a maximum stay of three months.
The eVisa is solely for tourism or Umrah, not paid work; entry remains subject to border conditions and the immigration officer's discretion.
The terms record a 2025 Hajj-season Makkah restriction from 29 April 2025 through 11 June 2025; later operational restrictions must be checked separately.

conflicts.explanation: Saudi Arabia's current official Ministry of Tourism terms expressly name Brazil in the permitted-country list, require a valid permitted-country passport, and say an accepted eVisa is emailed. The generic registration page's default message without a nationality selection does not contradict that direct rule.

unresolved.reason: No current Afghan or Brazilian authority source establishes a usable ordinary Brazilian-passport short-visitor route and actual issuance timing. Operational restrictions are not a normalized status.

No current BVI authority directly maps an ordinary Brazilian passport to a short-visitor route. United Kingdom rules, positive-list omission and conditional third-country-document routes are not transferred to the British Virgin Islands.

Burkina Faso's official Brasília guidance identifies electronic filing generally but does not establish ordinary Brazilian-passport eligibility or actual electronic issuance. Portal availability is not proof for this pair.
No current Central African or Brazilian authority maps an ordinary Brazilian passport to a short-visitor mission, electronic or border issuance route.
No current accessible Chadian primary source directly establishes ordinary Brazilian-passport visitor eligibility and actual issuance timing. An eVisa service alone is insufficient.

Comorian law and the current Brazil-Comoros agreement do not establish an ordinary Brazilian tourist's actual advance, electronic or arrival issuance timing; the bilateral waiver is limited to diplomatic, official and service passports.

The current Brazil-Congo visa-waiver material is limited to diplomatic, official and service passports. No current authority establishes ordinary Brazilian visitor treatment and actual issuance timing.

Côte d'Ivoire's Brazilian embassy and airport workflow describe routes for non-nationals generally, but neither maps an ordinary Brazilian passport to a confirmed pre-travel or border-issued visitor result.
Djibouti's current state e-government page proves electronic delivery generally but supplies no ordinary Brazilian-passport eligibility schedule. An online application alone is insufficient.
No current Guinea-Bissau or Brazilian authority establishes whether an ordinary Brazilian visitor receives a visa through a mission, electronically or at arrival.
Federal Iraq's current eVisa service requires a country-and-passport-type result, but no current ordinary Brazilian result was established. Kurdistan Region rules are not an Iraq-wide baseline.

Kuwait's current tourism service does not establish an unconditional ordinary Brazilian-passport visitor baseline or actual issuance timing. Sponsor, residence and portal-registration routes are excluded.
Liberia's arrival route depends on the availability of a Liberian embassy in the traveler's country, so it does not establish a Brazilian-passport-only visitor baseline.
The current Brazil-Mali agreement is limited to diplomatic, official and service passports. No current ordinary Brazilian visitor issuance route and timing is established.

Niger's current Foreign Ministry page retains bilateral and community-agreement exceptions and a residence-dependent mission route. It does not identify Brazil's ordinary-passport treatment or one unconditional issuance timing.

No current DPRK or Brazilian authority establishes an available ordinary Brazilian short-visitor route and actual issuance timing. Permission, security and operational controls are not normalized statuses.

Palestinian access depends on Israeli-controlled crossings, permits, identity records, security conditions and route-specific rules. No current source establishes a Palestine-wide ordinary Brazilian-passport status.
Sierra Leone's official eVisa material describes approval and terminal issuance but does not publish ordinary Brazilian-passport eligibility. It does not establish one Brazilian visitor route.
No current South Sudanese source maps ordinary Brazilian-passport visitor travel to an actual mission, electronic or border issuance timing. The eVisa portal is not an eligibility schedule.

The current Brazil-Sudan agreement is limited to diplomatic, official and service passports. No current Sudanese or Brazilian authority establishes ordinary Brazilian visitor eligibility and actual issuance timing amid disrupted operations.
No current Syrian or Brazilian authority establishes ordinary Brazilian-passport visitor eligibility and actual electronic, mission or border issuance timing.

Turkmenistan's current migration authority describes visa and invitation functions generally but does not distinguish an ordinary Brazilian tourist's actual issuance timing from invitation-dependent or special processing.
